title: [CI] Add cdk synth validation for all examples to CI pipeline
description:
Add a CI step that runs `cdk synth` on every example app across all constructs and languages. The step should:
1. Run jsii-pacmak to build local artifacts for each package
2. Install local artifacts into each non-TypeScript example
3. Run `cdk synth` in each example directory and assert exit 0
4. Collect and report any synth failures

Integrate into the existing Nx pipeline as a new target (e.g. nx run-many --target=synth-examples --all). Ensure this runs in CI on every PR.
